note: City of Oconto campground in a bend of the Oconto River beside the Holtwood sports fields, 30 min N of Green Bay, with a boat launch, canoe/kayak/tube rentals and mini golf. A long row of full-hookup river sites lines the bank road. Some interior sites are seasonal. --Claude
summary: City page, 2026 brochure (rates + site map), Google and imagery read. Waterfront not waterfront -> riverfront (sites R10-R13, R18-R41, nightly, full hookups, on the open bank of an ~80 m river). Pin 610 m off in a subdivision. Fees $38-40 written (manual) with $7 extra adult; phone booking with a holiday 3-night minimum; season May 1-Oct 31; hookups 50/W/S; facilities confirmed. About a quarter of sites seasonal.
flags: WATERFRONT UPGRADE: not waterfront -> riverfront. The 2026 site map puts the 'R' (River Grass, $40 daily) sites in one row on the river side of Log Road along the Oconto River's bank; the map marks none of R10, R11, R11B, R12, R13 or R18-R41 seasonal (no green dot) and they carry sewer, water and electric dots - so they are sold by the night. Imagery: the bank strip between Log Road and the river is open mown grass with site pedestals, about 15-35 m from the water along the east reach (44.8885,-87.8845) and around the north rim (44.8913,-87.8865); the river there is about 70-90 m wide, so riverfront, not creekside. R7, R8, R9B and R14-R17 in the same row are marked seasonal.

PIN (614 m off): stored 44.8853,-87.8903 is a road junction in the residential subdivision south of the Holtwood ballfields. The campground fills the river bend at about 44.8900,-87.8860 (office/entrance near 44.8893,-87.8875). Suggest 44.8900,-87.8860.
PHONE: null -> 920-834-7732 (the campground's own number on the city page and brochure; 920-834-7711 is City Hall). WEBSITE https://cityofoconto.com/camping/ confirmed (works).

LONG-STAY: daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal sites. A colour count of the brochure map finds about 40 green 'Seasonal Site' dots against roughly 115 electric sites plus tent sites - about a quarter seasonal, so not a seasonal-lease park. Local - no price gate.
GOOGLE: no listing of its own; 'Holtwood Sporting Complex & Park' 4.4 (219) covers the whole park.
UNSOURCED: stored 161 sites (152 + 9 primitive) and '68 acres / ~4,000 ft frontage' rest on old note prose; the brochure gives no total. Count left as stored.

INCLUSION EVIDENCE cites 'wisconsinharbortowns' and '~130 sites'; suggested replacement: 'City of Oconto camping page + 2026 brochure: river, gravel-pad and interior sites with 15/30/50-amp, water and sewer, $38-40 daily, reservations by phone, May 1-Oct 31 -> real municipal drive-in RV campground'.

LEAD: the city's second campground, City Park Campground (County Road N, Oconto; 920-834-7725; 'just feet from the stunning Bay of Green Bay', described as rustic; rules and map PDFs on https://cityofoconto.com/camping/), is not in campgrounds.json (no entry within 8 km). Not vetted.
